spans.s: Here (referring to time, place or direction); in this place or case. नेहाभिक्रमनाशो$स्ति
In this world (opp. परत्र or अमुत्र); oft. with जगति;
In this case; in this book or system.
Now, at this time. [cf. Zend. idha]. -Comp. -अमुत्र ind. in this world and the next world, here and there; cf. इहामुत्रार्थभोगविरागः । शाङ्करभाष्य on ब्रह्मसूत्र
. -आगत a. come here. -इहind. here and there, now and then, repeatedly. ˚मातृa.
whose mother is here and there, that is, everywhere; समानो वां जनिता भ्रातरा युवं यमाविहेहमातरा
of whose mothers one is here and one there. -कालः this life. -क्रतु, -चित्त a. whose intentions or thoughts are centred in this world or place, इहैवैधि धनसनिरिहचित्त इहक्रतुः
. -भव or -तन a. belonging to this world. -लोकः this world or life; ˚के in this world; cf. श्रेयो भोक्तुंभैक्ष्यमपीह लोके
. -समये ind. here, now, at such a time as this. -स्थ a. standing here. -स्थान a. one whose residence is on the earth.
Wish, desire; जलनिधिमकरोत्तरीतुमीहाम् Rām.; cf. also हन्तुं क्रोधवशादीहां चक्राते नौ परस्परम् Ki. see अनीह also.
. -Comp. -अर्थिन् a. aiming at any object, seeking wealth; वैश्यस्येहार्थिनो$ष्टमे (कार्यम्)
इहत्य [ihatya], a. [इह-त्यप्] Being here, of this place or world.
To regard, consider, look upon; सर्वभूतस्थमात्मानम्... ईक्षते योगयुक्तात्मा
To take into account, care for; नाभिजनमीक्षते
To think, reflect; स ऐक्षत लोकान्नु सृजै Ait.
. तत्तेज ऐक्षत बहु स्यां प्रजायेय Ch.
To look to, or to investigate, the good or bad luck of any one (with dat. of the person); कृष्णाय ईक्षते गर्गः Sk. (शुभाशुभं पर्यालोचयति)
to care for, take into account.
